2609.31201.title: Samples, Sources, Space: Decomposing Data Scale in Spatially Structured Representation Learning of Human Brain Microarchitecture
2609.31201.paper_summary: Scaling studies typically represent training data by a single count of samples. For hierarchically and spatially structured data, however, the same number of samples can be drawn from few or many sources and distributed differently across the underlying domain. We therefore study data scaling as an allocation problem, separating unique sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage. We study this decomposition in microscopic whole-brain histology, where a source is an individual brain, and a sample is an image patch at a specific spatial location. Across 93 controlled pretraining runs of a contrastive model that uses spatial proximity for supervision, we vary data allocation, compute, and model capacity over 11.6 million spatially anchored image patches from 21 human brains. Performance improves with more unique samples, broader spatial coverage, additional compute, and larger model capacity. At fixed sample count, distributing samples across one to 18 subjects produces no detectable improvement, even though representations generalize substantially better to subjects encountered during pretraining. Inter-subject variation therefore strongly affects generalization, but additional subjects provide no benefit when a fixed sample budget is distributed across more sources. These results establish sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage as distinct axes of data scaling in spatially structured representation learning.
2609.31201.paper_summary_zh: 縮放研究通常以單一樣本計數來表示訓練數據。然而，對於具有層次性和空間結構的數據，相同數量的樣本可以從少數或多數來源中提取，並在基礎領域中以不同方式分佈。因此，我們將數據縮放視為一個分配問題，分離獨特樣本計數、來源多樣性和空間覆蓋。我們在微觀全腦組織學中研究這一分解，其中來源是個別大腦，樣本是特定空間位置的圖像區塊。在93次受控的對比模型預訓練運行中，該模型使用空間接近性進行監督，我們在來自21個人類大腦的1160萬個空間錨定圖像區塊上變化數據分配、計算和模型容量。隨著更多獨特樣本、更廣泛的空間覆蓋、額外的計算和更大的模型容量，性能有所提升。在固定樣本計數的情況下，將樣本分佈在1到18個受試者之間並未產生可檢測的改善，即使表示在預訓練期間對遇到的受試者有顯著更好的泛化。因此，受試者之間的變異強烈影響泛化，但當固定樣本預算分配到更多來源時，額外的受試者並未帶來任何好處。這些結果確立了樣本計數、來源多樣性和空間覆蓋作為空間結構表示學習中數據縮放的不同軸。
